verdict.text: Albania pledges a 20.9% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual (condition not read). A later submission, NDC 3.0, was filed on 2026-09-16; it has not been read, so no figure here comes from it. 66 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (20). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 12 MtCO₂e, DS-35 6.7 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 20.9% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 52.6 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: Reduce CO2 emissions compared to the baseline scenario in the period of 2016 and 2030 by 11.5%, which means 708 kT carbon-dioxide emission reduction in 2030. It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.53°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.17°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
